correctness.rationale: At n>=10 a five-consecutive-vertex window has seven host edges; no window with >=4 deletions occurs except probability <=35 n q^4. In that event singleton runs of any connected-component label force 4 local missing edges, so each component forms a contiguous arc, each boundary exactly a 3-edge missing wall, and K=max(1,W). Wall indicators have probability q^3, adjacent intersection q^5 and independent otherwise. For n q^3->lambda>0, factorial moments of cluster configurations yield a simple rate-lambda PPP. Given k>=2 points, cyclic gaps from a uniformly chosen wall are Dirichlet(1,...,1), giving connectivity e^-lambda(1+lambda), maximum size CDF via simplex inclusion-exclusion, mean H_k/k.
